system.description:
• Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • No Disadvantage while Duel's Rhythm is on (only one enemy in your reach).
  • If both attacks hit, Encore: the second hit adds your Charisma modifier to damage again, as Opening Flourish does.

activities.name: Dazzling Combo
activities.text: One additional weapon attack as part of your attack action, with Disadvantage that no Advantage cancels. If both hit, Encore: the second hit adds your Charisma modifier to damage again.

activities.name: Dazzling Combo (Duel's Rhythm on)
activities.text: No Disadvantage on the extra attack (Duel's Rhythm on). If both hit, Encore: the second hit adds your Charisma modifier to damage again.
